purpose: Teach: 悩まさ/東側/闘病/口論/丹/いとう/づらく/粗

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、戦中の人々が悩まされた問題、丁寧に扱っていますね。
lines.en: Ren, your paper handles the wartime issues that troubled people with real care.
lines.style: Warm, observant praise. Measured pace. Eyes bright with genuine recognition. Slight lean forward — the teacher noticing when a student has done the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。冷戦期、東側陣営の社会、研究しました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on Eastern Bloc societies during the Cold War.
lines.style: Careful, attentive. Words chosen precisely. Slight tension in the shoulders — wanting to get it right. The soft voice of someone still learning to trust their own thinking.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 闘病しながら、執筆を続けた作家、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: The writer who kept writing while dealing with illness — that was a striking choice.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuinely moved. Slower tempo on the middle phrase. The teacher reflecting aloud, inviting him into that reflection with her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学者の間で、口論、激しかった時代でした。
lines.en: Yes. It was a time when scholars had fierce disagreements about all of it.
lines.style: Slight quickening on 'fierce.' Not nervous — just more animated. Still measured, but the topic has caught him. Small acknowledgment at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 丹念な資料調査、論文に重みを加えていますね。
lines.en: Your careful research into the sources really gives the paper weight.
lines.style: Direct, steady approval. The 'careful research' lands with genuine respect. Slight nod in the voice — this is what matters and she sees it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。労をいとうことなく、続けてきた研究です。
lines.en: Yes. It's research I've kept going with, without cutting corners.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath the formality. Not boasting — just stating what's true. Slight breath after 'yes,' like he's steadying himself to be honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 読み手にとって、入りづらく感じる節、修正されましたね。
lines.en: You've actually revised those sections that felt hard to enter for the reader.
lines.style: Gentle recognition. The praise is specific and real. Teacher-warm, not condescending. The smallest smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。粗削りだった初稿から、随分、整いました。
lines.en: Yes. The first draft was rough, but it's come together a lot since then.
lines.style: Relief and modest satisfaction. Breath at the end like he can finally exhale. Not triumphant — just real. The quiet confidence of someone who put in the work.
